The climate in Malmö

Malmö is about 11 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 21°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 1°C. Around 690 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in October (about 75 mm). The highest temperature in Malmö in 2015–2024 was 30°C (5 July 2015) and the lowest −11°C (18 January 2016).

Best time to visit Malmö

The most pleasant weather in Malmö is usually in June, July and August: average highs are between 20°C and 21°C, with up to 13 days of rain a month.
